Commentary.Commentary: Right then, Pakistan have completed the clean sweep here. Babar Azam and his teammates gather around the trophy and begin their celebrations. The hosts would be wondering what they could have achieved if they won the two close encounters but they definitely have a lot of positives to take back from this series. The next assignment for the Netherlands is the T20 World Cup in Australia. Pakistan though will head down to UAE for the Asia Cup. Their first encounter of the campaign is going to against India which will be played on 28th August 2022. The first ball will be at 7.30 pm IST (2 pm GMT). You can join us early for the build-up. Till then, take care and goodbye!

Babar Azam, the victorious skipper says that he is definitely happy with the team's performance and gives all the credit to the boys as they bowled well in the second innings. Says Naseem Shah has been wonderful. Adds He bowled well with the new ball and also in the death overs. Adds that all the bowlers bowled well. Claims that early on the wicket wasn’t good and the ball didn’t come to bat. Credits the Netherlands and says that they bowled really well.

Scott Edwards, the captain of the Netherlands is in for a chat. He says that he is incredibly proud of the boys. Adds that a little bit of inexperience at the back cost them the game. Mentions all the players played really well. Adds that it sort of caps off how the summer has been. Ends by saying the boys have surely grown over the course.

Naseem Shah wins the Man of the Match award for his sensational spell with the ball. He says that he used the pitch early on when the ball was seaming. Claims that he bowled in good areas and that helped him. Adds that when he performs well and the team wins he feels really good. Mentions that this performance is important for him since his ODI career just started. Thanks the crowd for coming from all over Europe and credits them for providing a lot of support.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Earlier in the innings, after opting to bat first, Babar Azam played a lone battle with the blade. Netherlands were excellent with the ball from the word go. Vivian Kingma and Bas de Leede combined for five wickets. They also kept the run rate in check throughout the innings. It was a complete team performance from them. During the chase, Netherlands kept losing wickets whenever any of their players seemed to have their eye in and eventually ended up on the losing side.

Pakistan will be very happy with the way they came back in this innings! They started off brightly with their pacers doing the trick. Although, there was a period when Pakistan found it difficult to take wickets at regular intervals. Nonetheless, their spinners kept things tight with the ball and did not let the batters score freely. It was Mohammad Wasim and Naseem Shah who were the game-changers for them. They both combined for nine wickets and made sure they get their side over the victory line. Naseem Shah stood out with the ball with his fi-fer.

The Netherlands came mighty close this time around but were unable to seal the game! Just like the opposition the hosts were off to a slow start. The Netherlands lost two wickets inside the Powerplay. It was Vikramjit Singh who took his time to settle in and made sure to put away the bad balls although he slipped up straightaway after his half-ton. Later, Tom Cooper also displayed his batting skills and smacked 62 runs. The Netherlands were ahead for most part of the game but they could not hold their nerves in the death overs. They kept losing wickets at regular intervals and in the end, the lack of experience in their tail-enders took the game away from them.

A fascinating game of ebbs and flows. Pakistan have done really well here to come back in the game and complete the clean sweep. They have also added more 10 points to their tally in the World Cup Super League standings. Netherlands were in the game for the most part of it but were unable to get over the finish line here.

OUT! CLEANED UP! Mohammad Wasim gets the final wicket here. The Netherlands have come so close but could not get over the line. Mohammad Wasim bowls a low full toss at the stumps. Aryan Dutt swings but misses and Mohammad Wasim hits the off pole. That brings the end to the Dutch innings and Pakistan win by 9 runs. They whitewash the series 3-0.

FOUR! What a good start to the over! Mohammad Wasim goes really full and on the pads, Aryan Dutt flicks this to the left of short fine leg and the ball rushes to the deep backward sqaure leg for four runs. 10 needed from 5 now!
Yorker in line with the stumps, Aryan Dutt digs this out and rushes across for a single. 14 runs are needed in 6 balls!
This is short as well and outside off, Vivian Kingma plays this to short third man and gets off the mark with a single.
Back-of-a-length delivery outside off, Vivian Kingma fends this on the back foot.

OUT! RUN OUT! The Dutch are falling apart now. It is a length ball, angled down leg. Shariz Ahmad flicks it down to fine leg. Mohammad Wasim sprints to his left from the deep and throws it to the keeper. Mohammad Haris collects and clips the bails off in a flash. The square leg umpire raises his finger. Vivian Kingma is the last man in for Netherlands.
Good-length delivery nipping in from outside off, Shariz Ahmad taps the ball to cover.
WIDE! Straying down leg and they give an extra run as the umpire says this is wide.
Aryan Dutt is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Naseem Shah gets his maiden five-wicket haul in ODI cricket! What an achievement for the young man! Naseem Shah bowls this on a good length and outside off, Logan van Beek thumps this towards deep mid-wicket. He connects well but finds Mohammad Nawaz in the deep. He looks really disappointed. 18 runs are needed from 11 now!
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Nawaz b Naseem Shah

Commentary.Commentary: Slower short ball outside off, Logan van Beek pulls this once again and takes a single as the ball goes to deep square leg.
Short ball and just outside off, Logan van Beek miscues his pull to deep backward square leg for two runs.
Good-length delivery in line with the stumps. Flicked through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Shahnawaz Dahani goes full once again on the pads, looking for the yorker. Shariz Ahmad flicks this to deep square leg for a single.
This one is on middle and leg from a good length, Logan van Beek misses and hits his pads to roll towards short fine leg for a leg bye.
Shahnawaz Dahani bowls this full and into the pads, Shariz Ahmad clips this to deep backward square leg for a single.
Netherlands need 26 runs off 18 balls. Shahnawaz Dahani comes back into the attack to get Pakistan closer to the finish line here.
Naseem Shah bowls this on a good length and in line with the stumps. Shariz Ahmad knocks the ball to mid on for a quick single.
WIDE! Angling down leg from a fuller length. The umpire says this is wide.
Good-length delivery from outside off, Shariz Ahmad hangs his bat out to dry and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Short ball aimed for the body. Logan van Beek goes to pull and gets hit on the helmet. A quick concussion test and we are set to go on.
Another slower delivery short and outside off, Shariz Ahmad plays this down to third man for a run.
Naseem Shah bowls this on a good length and outside off, Shariz Ahmad feels for the ball and gets beaten.
Short ball bowled slower in the air and outside off, Logan van Beek guides this to third man for a single.
LEG BYE! This is angled in full, into the pads. Logan van Beek looks to flick it away but misses. It goes out off his pads. They collect a leg bye.
Length ball, on off, blocked out.
WIDE! High full toss going down leg. The umpire indicates wide but that is clearly a no ball. The umpires have missed that one.
Shariz Ahmad is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! The dangerman departs and Pakistan will feel they have this one in the bag! Mohammad Wasim bowls a full delivery in line with the stumps, Tom Cooper flicks this high towards deep mid-wicket but the bat wobbles in his hand and he does not get the elevation. Fakhar Zaman comes running in from the deep and takes a wonderful catch with two hands diving in front. The Netherlands will be devastated.
Commentary.Howout: c Fakhar Zaman b Mohammad Wasim

Commentary.Commentary: Mohammad Wasim bowls this full and angling into the pads, Logan van Beek gets an inside edge onto the pads, and the ball rolls to third man for a single. Pakistan have reviewed this and UltraEDGE confirms bat is involved.
Mohammad Wasim bowls this full and outside off, Tom Cooper goes for a drive and gets an inside edge to the leg side. They steal a single.
Mohammad Wasim bowls a back-of-a-length delivery at 137 clicks and angles it into the batter. Tom Cooper looks to pull and gets an inside edge onto his body.
Length ball, on off, blocked out.
Logan van Beek makes his way to the crease. He will really want to try and get his team over the finish line.

OUT! TIMBER! Naseem Shah strikes every single time when his side is in a spot of bother. He picks up his four-fer. It is a full-length ball, outside off. It nips in off the deck. Teja Nidamanuru leans forward and tries to defend it out but misses. It goes through the gap between his bat and pad. It goes through to rattle the stumps.
Full length, on off. Cooper pushes it to cover for a single.
Short ball, on off. Teja Nidamanuru pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Good length, on off. Cooper shuffles and looks to pull it away. It takes an inside edge and goes to the off side off his tummy. They take one.
Agha Salman saves a run here! Fuller, on off. Cooper drives it to cover. Salman dives to his left and makes a sharp stop.

LEG BYE! A length ball, on the pads, Tom Cooper looks to flick it away but misses. It goes towards point off the thigh pad. They collect a leg bye. Teja Nidamanuru would've been run out if the fielder was able to get his throw on the stumps at the striker's end.
On off, driven through covers for another single.
Full length, on off. Cooper eases it past the bowler for one more.
Another single now as this is worked down to long on.
Full length, on off. Cooper pushes it through covers for one run.
Full length, on leg stump. Teja Nidamanuru hits it down to long on for one.
Mohammad Wasim (7-0-24-2) is now back into the attack.
Darted on the pads, Teja Nidamanuru flicks it to square leg for one. Netherlands need 44 off 42 balls.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Cooper inside-edges it to fine leg. They take one.
It is floated and full, on off. Cooper reverse paddles it to short third man.
Darted on the pads, Teja Nidamanuru flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
WIDE! Yet again down the leg side. Teja Nidamanuru is unable to tickle it away. Wide called.
WIDE! Fuller, down leg. Teja Nidamanuru misses his flick. Wided.
Short ball, outside off. Teja Nidamanuru stays back and cuts it to backward point. Babar Azam dives to his left and makes a half stop. They take two runs.
This one comes in with the arm, full and off. Cooper drives it to mid off for one.
Length ball, on off, blocked out.
Full length, on off. Cooper drives it back to the bowler. It hits Dahani on the foot and lobs towards mid off. They take one.
Zips past the outside edge! Good-length ball, in the channel. Cooper looks to push it away but misses. Dahani makes a loud appeal yet again.
Swing and a miss! A short ball, outside off. Cooper stays back and looks to cut it away but misses. Shahnawaz Dahani makes an appeal for caught behind but the umpire is unmoved.
This one is angled into the pads, on a length. Cooper looks to flick it away but misses. He gets pinged high on his pads.
Length ball, on the pads, Cooper flicks it to square leg.
Full length, sliding down leg. Cooper tucks it to short fine leg. Cooper is a bit late into his charge but is quick to get to the other side. Netherlands need 53 off 54 balls.
This is angled into the pads, Cooper defends it to covers.
Flatter one, on off. Cooper blocks it back to the bowler.
Floated and full, on off. Cooper gets it to short third man off the outside edge.
It is full, on middle. Teja Nidamanuru comes down the track and drives it down the ground, past the bowler. They take one.
Fuller, on the pads, Cooper flicks it to square leg and rotates the strike.
End of Powerplay 2! Now, 5 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle until the end of the innings.
Shahnawaz Dahani ends this over with a yorker in line with the stumps, Teja Nidamanuru digs it out to mid on.
Short ball bowled slower and outside off, Teja Nidamanuru goes for the pull but is beaten by the pace.
Shahnawaz Dahani bowls this short and outside off, Tom Cooper goes to pull and gets top edge into the vacant third man region.
Bowls this one full and in line with the stumps, Tom Cooper knocks the ball to mid on.
Shahnawaz Dahani bangs in a short ball, Tom Cooper initially goes for the pull and then decides against it.
Shahnawaz Dahani bowls this on a good length and into the pads, Teja Nidamanuru clips this off his pads to the leg side for a leg bye.
Loopy delivery full and on middle, Tom Cooper clips this towards square leg.
Flighted full outside off, Tom Cooper defends this back to the bowler.
Short and outside off, Teja Nidamanuru works this to deep cover for a single.
FOUR! This is a good shot! Mohammad Nawaz flights this one full outside off, Teja Nidamanuru is out of his crease as he thumps this towards long off for a boundary.
This is full and in line with the stumps, Teja Nidamanuru fends this back down the pitch.
Mohammad Nawaz bowls this full and outside off, Teja Nidamanuru strokes this to covers.
FIFTY FOR COPPER! He receives a warm round of applause from the crowd. It is full, outside off. Cooper drives it to sweeper cover and comes back for the second run.
FOUR! A much-needed boundary for Netherlands. It is full, sliding down leg. Tom Cooper glances it down to fine leg and finds the boundary.
Length, on top of off. Cooper blocks it out to safety.
Good length, on the pads, Cooper nudges it to the leg side.
Eight consecutive dots for Shahnawaz Dahani. Length, on off. Cooper stays back and defends it out.

It is a length ball, around off, nips in a touch off the deck. Tom Cooper stays inside the crease and looks to clip it away. He gets an inside edge onto his pads. Shahnawaz Dahani though thinks he has got in man and appeals the umpire says no.
A maiden for Mohammad Nawaz. This should put some pressure on the opposition. It is flatter, on the pads, Teja Nidamanuru blocks it to the leg side.
Quicker and full, on off. Teja Nidamanuru comes down the track and gets it to mid-wicket off the inner half.
Loops it up, on off. Teja Nidamanuru defends it out watchfully.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Teja Nidamanuru tucks it to short mid-wicket.
On off, blocked out.
A short ball, outside off. Teja Nidamanuru looks to chase it but misses.
Googly once again tosses up outside off, Teja Nidamanuru goes to play this to the offside but miscues it to long on for one.
Flights this one outside off, Tom Cooper hits this uppishly over the bowler's head. Lands in no man's land. He gets a  little lucky here.
FOUR! Second boundary of the over! Zahid Mahmood drops this a fraction short and wide outside off, Tom Cooper stays back and cuts the late past backward point for another boundary.
Flights this one full and outside off, Teja Nidamanuru drives this to deep cover for a single.
Zahid Mahmood bowls this short and outside off, Teja Nidamanuru finds the cover fielder with his shot.

FOUR! Good start to the over for the Netherlands! Zahid Mahmood bowls this full and outside off, Teja Nidamanuru gets across the drives this straight past the mid on fielder for a boundary to long on.
Slower delivery bowled full and outside off, Tom Cooper strokes this to short cover.
This is on a length and in line with the stumps, Teja Nidamanuru looks to play this leg side but goes off his pads for a leg bye.
Naseem Shah bowls this fuller and in line with the stumps. Tom Cooper looks to defend and gets a thickish edge to point. They take a single.
This is on a good length and outside the off pole, Tom Cooper gets across and taps the ball to mid on.
WIDE! Bowls this short and angling down leg, Tom Cooper does not bother with it and is called wide.
Full once again and outside the off stump, Tom Cooper punches this towards mid off.
Naseem Shah bowls this full and just outside off, Teja Nidamanuru hits this back towards the bowler and the ball is collected by the mid on fielder. They taka a single.
Full and on middle. Cooper blocks it back to the bowler on the front foot.
Around off, defended to the off side.
On off, blocked back to the bowler.
Floated and full, outside off. Tom Cooper slashes it through covers. The fielder fumbles and they take two.
Full and outside off. Teja Nidamanuru pushes it past mid off for a single.
Tossed up and full, outside off. Cooper drives it to sweeper cover for one.
Nice way to get off the mark here! It is full, straying on the pads, Teja Nidamanuru flicks it through square leg. The fielder in the deep fumbles and the batters take two.
Full length, on off. Teja Nidamanuru leans in and pushes it to cover.
WIDE! It is full, drifting down leg. Teja Nidamanuru leaves it alone. Wided.

Drinks break! Pakistan are taking control of this game now. This looks like an uphill task for the Netherlands now. Nonetheless, Netherlands need less than a run a ball but they don't have much wickets in the bank. Pakistan will be eyeing to take a couple more wickets to take the game away from the opposition. Teja Nidamanuru is the new batter in the middle.

OUT! TIMBER! Naseem Shah comes back into the attack and takes his third wicket now. It is a length ball, on off, it nips away a touch off the deck. Scott Edwards tries to defend it out but misses. The ball zips past the outside edge and clips the off pole on its way. A brillaint delivery to get rid of the Netherlands skipper here. Pakistan are right back in the contest.
Full length, on the pads, Scott Edwards clips it to short mid-wicket.
Fraction short, on middle and leg. Cooper flicks it through square leg for a single.
A length ball, on the stumps. Cooper gets behind the line and defends it back to the bowler.
Change. Naseem Shah (5-0-14-2) is back into the attack now.

FOUR! Scott Edwards has played this beautifully! Zahid Mahmood flights this one full and outside off, Scott Edwards reverse sweeps the ball to the left of short third man and finds the boundary to get his first four.
This is straying into the pads on a fuller length, Tom Cooper clips this to deep square leg for a run.
Bowls a googly from outside off and on a fuller length, Tom Cooper looks to play this off side and gets an inside edge to mid-wicket.
Tosses this one full and outside off, Tom Cooper knocks this straight to the cover fielder.
Short and outside off, Tom Cooper looks to cut this late but gets beaten by the extra bounce.
Zahid Mahmood flights this one full outside off, Scott Edwards strokes this past cover to wide long off for a single.
Keeps bowling on a good length and outside off, Tom Cooper comes across the stumps and stands tall as he taps this back down the pitch.
Mohammad Wasim serves this on a good length and outside off, Scott Edwards guides this to third man for a run and gets off the mark.
Mohammad Wasim bowls a good length delivery nipping back in, Scott Edwards blocks this back to the bowler.
Scott Edwards makes his way out to the crease.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Mohammad Wasim gets his man! He bowls the exact same delivery outside off from a good length and Vikramjit Singh once again slashes at this. This time he gets a faint edge that goes through to the keeper. Mohammad Haris dives forward and takes another good catch behind the wicket. Pakistan have finally broken this partnership.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Haris b Mohammad Wasim

Commentary.Commentary: This is on a good length and outside off, Vikramjit Singh goes to cut this but the ball is too close and gets beaten.
Mohammad Wasim bowls this full and outside off, Vikramjit Singh hits this firmly to the cover fielder.
It is full, sliding down leg. Cooper misses his flick and gets rapped on the pads. A stifled appeal from the bowler but the umpire is unmoved. Going down leg.
Darted on the pads, Cooper looks to clip it away. It lobs off the leading edge and lands on his left.
Fuller, on the pads, Cooper tucks it to mid-wicket.

FIFTY FOR SINGH! He has been sensational in this series. It is tossed up, full and on off. Singh uses his feet and taps it down the ground for one. He raises his bat and soaks himself in applauds. An incredible knock from him. He would know that the job is still half done.
Fuller, just outside off. Cooper leans in and drives it to deep point for a single.
Full and on off, Singh pushes it to long off for a single.
It is full, on off, Cooper pushes it hard into the deck. It meets the bowler on a bounce.
A length ball, outside off. Cooper gets behind the line and blocks it back to the bowler.
On a good-length, angled across the left-hander. Singh stays back and punches it to cover-point. They take one more.
Full length, on off, Cooper pushes it to cover for one.
A length ball, on off, bloked out.
Back of a length, outside off. Cooper stands tall and looks to cut it away but misses.
Mohammad Wasim comes back into the attack here.
Tossed up, on off, flicekd to mid-wicket.
It is flatter, outside off. Singh shuffles across and nudges it to the leg side.
On off, defended out.

FOUR! This is good innovation from Vikramjit Singh! Good to see him try something different and accumulate runs. Mohammad Nawaz bowls this full and outside off, Vikramjit Singh getsd across the stumps and paddles the ball over the keeper's head for four more runs.
Bowls this one on middle and leg from a fuller length, Vikramjit Singh taps this towards mid-wicket.
Mohammad Nawaz bowls this short and outside off, Tom Cooper uses the crease and punches the ball to deep cover.
Shahnawaz Dahani bowls a yorker angling into the pads, Tom Cooper clips this to deep backward square leg for a single.
WIDE! This one is dropped really short and goes well over the batter. The square leg umpire indicates that it is wide.
Bowls this one full as well and outside off, Tom Cooper hits this firmly towards mid off.
Shahnawaz Dahani goes a touch fuller this and gets the ball to nip back in. Worked towards mid on.
This is slightly short as well, and outside off, Tom Cooper knocks this towards cover.
Back-of-a-length delivery outside off, Tom Cooper stands tall and punches the ball back to the bowler.
FOUR! Shahnawaz Dahani bowls a well-directed bouncer, Tom Cooper goes for the pull and gets an outside edge onto the helmet and then over the keeper's head for a boundary!
Looped up, on off, A great over by Nawaz just two runs off it.
Full and outside off. Singh pushes it out to mid off.
It is full, on off. Singh nudges it towards mid-wicket.
On off, defended out.
On off, Singh hits it down to long off for a couple now.
Flatter one, on the pads, Singh stays back and flicks it to square leg.
Full once again and outside off, Vikramjit Singh taps the ball towards mid off and takes off for a single. Direct hit and he was a goner.
Shahnawaz Dahani serves this a touch fuller on the pads, Vikramjit Singh nudges the ball to short mid-wicket.
This is on a good length and outside off, Vikramjit Singh goes for the drive and is beaten.
Delivers this back of a length and outside off, Tom Cooper shimmies down the wicket and strokes the ball to deep cover for a single.
WIDE! Shahnawaz Dahani bangs this in short and this has been called wide by the leg umpire.
Bowls this on a good length and outside off, Tom Cooper strokes this to deep point for a couple of runs. That is the fifty-run partnership between these two.
Shahnawaz Dahani bowls this full and outside off, Tom Cooper mistimes his shot to cover.
Full and on off, Singh gets forward and blocks it out solidly.
On middle and leg, Cooper tucks it to mid-wicket for one.
Full and on middle. Cooper pushes it to covers.
On off, pushed out to safety.
It is floated and full, around off, this one holds its line. Tom Cooper gets on his front foot to defend it out. It takes the outside edge and goes past the keeper. They take two.
Outside off, punched past mid off for one.
It is full, outside off. Cooper slashes it past backward point. They take two.
Floated and full, outside off. Cooper pushes it to extra cover. Agha Salman there dives to his right and makes a sharp stop.
Full and on off, defended out.
A single now as this is tucked to mid-wicket.
Tossed up, on off, this one stays low off the deck. Cooper hits it to long off for one.
A googly now on the pads, Cooper looks to defend but misses. He gets rapped on his pads.
Floated and full, outside off. Singh blocks it back to the bowler.
Around off, blocked out.
Misifeld and four! Tossed up, full and on off. Singh drives it towards mid off. The fielder there lets the ball through him and it races away to the boundary.
On off, pushed to cover for another single.
Tossed up, on off. SIngh clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
A single now as this is worked through covers.
Fuller, on off, Singh eases it to the off side.
This is flicked to mid-wicket but not in the gap.
Fuller, on the pads, Singh clips it to the leg side.
Floated and full, outside off. Singh looks to chase it but misses.
Fuller, outside off. Cooper drives it through covers for one run.
On off, defended out.
Short and wide outside off, Vikramjit Singh cuts this late to point.
Loopy deloivery full outside off, Tom Cooper hits this to deep cover for one.
Mohammad Nawaz gets the ball to turn back into the batter, Vikramjit Singh worked to deep sqaure leg for a single.

An appeal for stumping the umpire takes it upstairs. It is tossed up, full and outside off. Tom Cooper leans in and tries to defend it out but misses. Mohammad Haris gathers the ball and clips the bails in a flash. The third umpire is involved. The replays confirm that Tom Cooper had his back leg grounded. The final decision is NOT OUT.
Short and close to the off pole, Tom Cooper cuts this to backward point,
Zahid Mahmood bowls this short and just outside off, Tom Cooper fends this down the picth.
Short and wide outside off, Vikramjit Singh cuts this to deep point for a single.
Full and outside off, Tom Cooper knocks this to long off for a run.
FOUR! Make that three boundaries!  This is full and on off, Vikramjit Singh plays this straight to long on for fur more runs.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! On a good length and outside off,  Vikramjit Singh plays this fine to third man for a boundary!
FOUR! This has been swatted away! Mohammad Wasim bowls a fraction short and outside off, Vikramjit Singh pulls this straight past the bowler to long on for a boundary.
This is full and outside off, Vikramjit Singh hits this hard towards mid off.
Bowls this on a good length once again and in line with the stumps, Tom Cooper taps this towards mid on and takes off for a run this time.
Mohammad Wasim bowls this on a good length and just outside off, Tom Cooper knocks this straight to mid on.
Scott Edwards walks out to the crease.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Cooper flicks it to mid-wicket for a single. A good over for Netherlands, 7 runs off it.
FOUR! Incredible shot! It is full and on off. Tom Cooper reverse-sweeps it past short third man. It races away to the fence.
Darted on the pads, Singh clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and on middle. Cooper stays back and pushes it to mid on for one.
On off, blocked out.
Tossed up, full and outside off. Cooper pushes it to cover.
Slightly short and outside off, Vikramjit Singh gets on his back foot and works this towards mid off.
Mohammad Wasim serves this on a good length and outside off, Vikramjit Singh knocks this to mid off.

Mohammad Wasim bowls this on a good length and outside off, Tom Cooper cuts this into the pitch towards point.
On the stumps, blocked out.
It is tossed up, outside off. Cooper drives it through covers on the half-volley. The fielder does well in the deep to save a boundary. They take three.
Fuller and on off. Cooper drives it uppishly towards short cover. It lands short of the fielder.
On off, defended out.
A googly now, sliding down leg. Tom Cooper looks to chase it but misses. It goes off his thigh pads.
Fuller one, on off. Singh pushes it to square on the off side. They cross for one.
Tom Cooper is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Mohammad Wasim gets one now and the Netherlands are in disarray! He bowls this a fraction slower,full and outside off, Bas de Leede gets the bottom edge to the keeper as the ball keeps a touch low. Mohammad Haris takes fine catch diving forward and the umpires check if the catch is taken cleanly. All good and the in-form Bas de Leede has to depart.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Haris b Mohammad Wasim

Commentary.Commentary: Is this out? The umpire takes it upstairs to confirm. Thesoft signal is NOT OUT. The UltraEdge shows that there is a spike as the ball passes the blade. The replays also confirm that Mohammad Haris takes a clean catch behind the sticks. The final decision is OUT.
Mohammad Wasim continues to bowl full and outside off, Bas de Leede knocks this to mid off.
Mohammad Wasim bowls this full and outside just wide of the off pole, Vikramjit Singh punches this towards mid on and takes off for a quick single.
This is slower delivery bowled on a good length and outside off, Vikramjit Singh gets beaten by the pace as he is early into the shot.
This is full as well and in line with the stumps, Vikramjit Singh knocks this to mid on.
Mohammad Wasim serves this full and just outside off, Bas de Leede clips this wide of mid on and takes a run.
Bas de Leede comes down the track and hits this full delivery to long on for a single.
Tossed up, full and outside off. Singh leans in and drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Fuller one, on the stumps, Singh eases it out to safety.
On off, defended out.
Fuller, on off, Singh flicks it to the leg side.
Floated and full, on off. Singh works it back to the bowler off the inner half.
Full length, on the pads, Singh clips it to mid-wicket for one.
Swing and a miss! A length ball, outside off. Singh looks to chase it but misses.
Wasim serves it full, outside off. Singh leans in and drives it to cover straight to the fielder.
Fuller one, on off. Vikramjit Singh defends it out solidly.
Length ball, outside off. Vikramjit Singh shuffles across and defends it out watchfully.
On a length, around off, defended out.
Agha Salman ends with a short ball outside off, Vikramjit Singh slashes this to deep point and takes a run to keep strike.
Fires in a quicker delivery on the pads, Vikramjit Singh clips this to short fine leg.
Loopy delivery on middle and leg, Bas de Leede taps this with soft hands towards mid-wicket and calls Vikramjit Singh for a run. They just about make it.
Similar delivery in line with the stumps, Bas de Leede blocks this towards the mid-wicket fielder.
Flights this one full and on off, Bas de Leede clips this mid-wicket on the front foot.
Agha Salman bowls this short and outside off, Vikramjit Singh strokes this to deep cover for a single.
End of Powerplay 1. Now, 4 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle until the end of the 40th over.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Bas de Leede hangs back and flicks it through square leg. They take two runs.
Full length, on off. Bas de Leede presses forward and defends it out.
A good-length ball, outside off. Bas de Leede looks to cut it away but misses.
Length ball, on the stumps. Bas de Leede blocks it out solidly. A stifled appeal from the bowler but the umpire shows no interest.
A length ball, on the pads, Singh clips it to fine leg for one.
A length ball, on off. Vikramjit Singh stays inside the crease and looks to flick it away but gets rapped high on his pads.
A length ball, outside off. Bas de Leede leaves it alone for the keeper. A wicket-taking over from Shah comes to an end.
Bas de Leede is the new man in.

OUT! TIMBER! Naseem Shah has his second! He bowls this from 'round the wicket and angles this one into the stumps from outside off. Musa Ahmad looks to work this leg side and gets beaten on his outside edge as the ball thumps into the top of the off stump. Pakistan players are all around the yound bowler in celebration and Musa Ahmad has to make the long walk back.
On a good length and outside the off stump. Musa Ahmad taps this to the cover fielder.
Naseem Shah goes a touch fuller and outside off, Musa Ahmad strokes this to cover.
This is in line with the stumps and on a good length, Musa Ahmad clips this to mid-wicket.
Naseem Shah bangs one in short and outside off, Musa Ahmad pulls this unconvincingly to deep backward square leg for a brace.
On a length, outside off, tapped to point.
A length ball, outside off. Musa Ahmad crunches it towards point. The fielder there dives to his left and makes a half stop. They take one.
A short ball, outside off, this one flies off the deck. Musa Ahmad looks to chase it but decides against it in the end.
A length ball, outside off. Ahmad hangs back and drives it uppishly towards covers. It lands short of the fielder there.
Good length, outside off. Musa Ahmad cuts it through cover-point for a brace.
Nicely bowled! A length ball, outside off, angled across the left-hander. Musa Ahmad looks to block it away but does so inside the line.
Length, on off, defended out.

Musa Ahmad almost chop on this time! A good length, in the channel. Musa Ahmad stays back and looks to push it through the line. It takes the inside edge and luckily for him it goes past the stumps, down to fine leg for one.
Four dots on the trot! Back of a length, outside off. Ahmad cuts it to cover but off the toe end.
A sharp bouncer, on off. Musa Ahmad sways away from the line of the delivery.
Good length, on off, blocked out solidly.
A length ball, on off. Ahmad shuffles across and nudges it to mid-wicket.
Good length, outside off. Vikramjit Singh shoulders his arms at it.
Full length, outside off, this one stays low off the deck. Vikramjit Singh looks to chase it but misses.
Full length, on the pads, Ahmad flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
A single now as this is pushed to covers.
A length ball, on top of off. Vikramjit Singh blocks it out watchfully.
FOUR! Nicely played A short ball, outside off. Vikramjit Singh stands tall and pulls it through square leg. It races away to the boundary.
Length ball, on off, tapped to point but straight to the fielder.
Naseem Shah bowls this a fraction short and outside off, Musa Ahmad slashes at this hard towards point and a half stop allows them to take two runs.
Naseem Shah goes full this time and on the pads, Musa Ahmad clips this towards deep backward square leg and Musa Ahmad is off the mark with a brace.
Good-length delivery shaping away from the batter, Musa Ahmad feels for the ball and he too gets beaten on the outside edge.
Naseem Shah bowls this on a good length and most pitching outside leg. Hits Musa Ahmad high on the pads and there is a huge appeal. The umpire says not out and Babar Azam does not review.
Musa Ahmad is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Pakistan have the first wicket! They have been threathening since the start and they have been finally rewarded! Naseem Shah goes slightly full and outside off, draws the batter into the drive. Max O'Dowd oblidges and gets a thick edge that flies to second slip. Agha Salman takes a sharp catch and Pakistan have their breakthrough!
Commentary.Howout: c Agha Salman b Naseem Shah

Commentary.Commentary: A length ball, on fourth stump. Max O'Dowd dabs it down to third man for one.
Good length, in the channel. Max O'Dowd hangs back and defends it into the deck.
Length ball, outside off, pushed to point.
A length ball, shaping in from outside off. Max O'Dowd gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Shahnawaz Dahani goes full and angling into the stumps, Max O'Dowd knocks this back down the pitch and the bowler puts his left hand out to stop the ball.
Shahnawaz Dahani goes past the edge again. This is back of a length and outside off, Max O'Dowd is unsure if he should fend this and goes past his outside edge.
Pakistan bowlers have beaten the edge far too many times today! This is also bowled on a good length and outside off, Vikramjit Singh plays a loose stroke and gets beaten.

FOUR! Edged and falls short of slip! Naseem Shah induces the edge this time as he bowls this on a good length and outside off, The slip fielders go for the ball but it lands safely and then beats them to run to the third man fence for a boundary.
Naseem Shah bowls this on a good length and outside off, Max O'Dowd feels for the ball and gets a thicking edge to third man for a run.
This one is full as well and straying onto the pads, Vikramjit Singh clips this wide of mid on and gets off the mark with a single.
Goes a bit fuller but still outside off, Vikramjit Singh blocks this towards cover.
Naseem Shah gets the ball to shape away from the left-hander and bowls this on a good length. Vikramjit Singh is beaten once again.
This is a low full toss outside off, should have been put away. Max O'Dowd finds the point fielder.
What a delivery! Shahnawaz Dahani bowls this back of a length and outside off, Max O'Dowd hangs his bat out to dry and gets beaten all ends up.

BYES! Shahnawaz Dahani goes slightly fuller and outside off, Vikramjit Singh goes for the expansive drive on the up and gets beaten on the outside edge. The keeper fumbles as well and the batters sneak a bye.
Continues bowling on a good length and well outside off. Vikramjit Singh is watchful and he leaves this one as well.
This is outside the off stump on a good length. Vikramjit Singh shoulders arms to this.
Shahnawaz Dahani starts off with a good length delivery outside off, Max O'Dowd looks to leave but the ball hits his bat and runs to third man as they take a single.
Shahnawaz Dahani to steam in from the other end with the second new ball.
Good-length delivery outside off stump, Vikramjit Singh taps this towards point.
Beaten! Naseem Shah bowls this closer to the off pole on a good length. Vikramjit Singh pushes at this and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Naseem Shah bowls this a touch fuller outside off, Vikramjit Singh stokes this straight to mid off.
Similar delivery bowled outside off, Vikramjit Singh is happy to watch this go to the keeper.
WIDE! Naseem Shah serves this even wider outside off from a good length. This has been called wide by the umpire though it seems like it is inside the tramline.
Bowls this on a good length and outside off. This is an easier leave for Vikramjit Singh.
Naseem Shah begins with a back-of-a-length delivery just outside off. The ball nips back in and Vikramjit Singh does well to leave this alone.
